notes.title: Puck Buddies Live Stream - Remote Play Event
notes.content:
Throughout the Remote Play Sale weekend, the designer of Puck Buddies will be playing with & against Remote Play guests, other members of the development team and the game's AI. When live, the developers will be interacting with the audience and answering their questions while playing.

Tune in, enjoy the action or try Puck Buddies out with your own Remote Play couch group:

🏒🐸 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201380/Puck_Buddies/]Puck Buddies store page[/url] 💥🎮
